name: CtrlS Mumbai Data Center Campus (Navi Mumbai, Ghansoli)
notes: Largest DC campus in Navi Mumbai (Ghansoli, Thane district). 13 DC buildings, ~3 mn sq ft, up to 700MW IT load capacity; DC1-5 operational (~119MW combined), DC6/DC7 upcoming (95MW).

name: STT GDC Navi Mumbai Campus (Airoli)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) India
notes: Existing STT GDC Navi Mumbai (Airoli) DCs operational; new ~90MW two-building campus on 6.6 acres at Airoli, first building ~325,000 sq ft from Q2 2024.

name: NTT DATA Navi Mumbai NAV1 (Mahape)
notes: NAV1 in Electronic Zone, MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); ~30MW IT load, ~5,000 racks.

name: NTT DATA Navi Mumbai NAV1A (second hyperscale campus)
notes: First building of NTT's second hyperscale DC campus in India at Navi Mumbai (Mahape/Airoli corridor, Thane district); ~400,000 sq ft, 5,000 racks, 30MW+ IT load.

name: NTT GDC Navi Mumbai 2 (Airoli)
notes: NAV2 facility at MIDC Road, Airoli, Navi Mumbai (Thane district).

name: Sify Navi Mumbai Data Center (Airoli / Rabale)
notes: Sify Airoli DC plus Mumbai 03 Rabale campus in the TTC industrial belt (Thane district); interconnects with NTT and hyperscale clouds.

name: Web Werks MUM-1 / Iron Mountain (Rabale)
notes: MUM-1/MUM-2 at Sigma IT Park, Thane-Belapur Road, MIDC Rabale, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); MUM-1 approx 6.3MW.

name: AdaniConneX Mumbai MH1 (Mahape)
notes: Hyperscale campus at Thane-Belapur Rd / Shil-Phata Mahape Rd, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); up to 1GW potential capacity, green/renewable powered.

name: Bridge Data Centres BBY01 (Navi Mumbai)
notes: ~350,000 sq ft facility in Navi Mumbai within the Thane-district DC corridor.

name: CapitaLand Data Centre Mumbai 01 (Airoli-Dighe)
notes: 108MW hyperscale campus at Airoli-Dighe, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); 2 buildings, 24 data halls, ~2.5-2.7MW per hall.

name: CapitaLand Data Centre Mumbai 02 (Navi Mumbai)
notes: Planned hyper-dense facility in Navi Mumbai, ~37MW IT load, liquid cooling, expected completion Q4 2026.

name: Colt DCS Airoli hyperscale data centre
notes: Announced INR ~8,500 crore hyperscale DC on ~15 acres at Airoli, Navi Mumbai (Thane district).

name: ESR Rabale MU1 data centre
notes: ESR commits INR ~900 crore (~US$100m) for DC on 3.25-acre site in the Rabale-Airoli corridor (Thane district).

name: L&T NMP 2 data centre (Mahape)
notes: 30MW campus, ~380,000 sq ft, Mahape, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); listed on datacentermap, development stage unverified.

name: Nxtra (Airtel) edge data centre, Thane
notes: Edge data centre in Thane city; Nxtra also announced two larger data centre campuses in Maharashtra.

name: Lodha Green Integrated Data Centre Park, Palava
notes: Green data centre park at Palava (Thane district); ~2GW / Rs 30,000 crore partnership (earlier Rs 1 trillion, 2.5GW MoU) with Maharashtra government.

name: Manipur State Data Centre (SDC) / Government Cloud
developer: Government of Manipur (Directorate of IT & Cyber Security)
notes: State e-governance data centre under NeGP in Imphal (state HQ area, Imphal West district); runs 24x7, hosts CCTNS and state applications; exact facility location not officially disclosed.
